newsitem.title: USA: Dole wins Texas - U.S. television networks.
newsitem.headline: Dole wins Texas - U.S. television networks.

text.p: Republican presidential challenger Bob Dole won the pivotal state of Texas, with 32 electoral votes, U.S. television networks said on Tuesday.

Minutes after polls closed in Texas at 8 p.m. EST (0100 GMT), the CNN, ABC and NBC networks projected Dole would win there. But he still lagged far behind President Bill Clinton, who had captured more than 200 electoral votes by mid-evening.
